hooks.command: if command -v gh >/dev/null 2>&1 && gh auth status >/dev/null 2>&1; then gh api repos/bottmk/infra/contents/scripts/check-github-issues.sh --jq '.content' 2>/dev/null | base64 -d | bash 2>/dev/null || true; elif [ -x "$HOME/.claude/bin/curl-with-shared-auth.sh" ]; then "$HOME/.claude/bin/curl-with-shared-auth.sh" GITHUB_ISSUES_TOKEN /github-issues 2>/dev/null || true; fi
